correctness.rationale: TARGET route: audited the literal admitted ledger normally. Independently re-ran the VT coset DP by forward and suffix recurrences (sum 2^25; residue-0 size 1290556; checksum(1^25)=13 confirming only 0^25 removed), codec roundtrips, VT deletion inversion with exhaustive preimage-uniqueness checks on 3000 random pairs plus all 25 deletions of 556 codewords, and jigsaw sync: machine-checked the Lemma 1 window exhaustions (d<=26: 4 combos; d=27..31: 20 combos; d=32 forgery condition), 1089 adjacent-pair exhaustive tests with zero window/truth mismatches, genuine-trace fractions 200/200 at every deletion position, corner patterns, and the 6346-block/203072-segment end-to-end suite logic. Rate arithmetic 32*20/1024=0.625>=0.60 and log2(1290556)/32≈0.6343613<0.68 uses exact integer counts with large margins. Two exposition slips (omitted second maximal coset residue 13; Lemma 2 'NOT a trace' aside) were corrected and are immaterial to the inequalities and zero-error theorem.
